headlines.title: Democrats win the largest House majority since 1992
headlines.description: Democrat Chuck Hubbard has defeated GOP Rep.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Van Hollen says ‘momentum is in our direction’ in battle for majority leader
headlines.description: Sen. Chris Van Hollen, D-Md., said “momentum is in our direction” on his bid to serve as the Senate majority leader in the next Congress

headlines.title: Trump hosts exclusive dinner for investors in his declining meme coin
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will reward top investors in his declining meme coin with an exclusive dinner Sunday night as Democrats focus future congressional probes on the president’s business dealings, including his crypto ventures.

headlines.title: Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed says he’s open to working with the Trump administration
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed said he’s open to working with Trump on an agenda to bring down costs and improve healthcare for Americans, just weeks after the three men lobbed attacks on each other during a tense campaign season.

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed catches president’s attention with pitch for ‘Trumpcare’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump responded on Saturday to Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed’s push for universal healthcare after the progressive Michigan Democrat pitched that it be called “Trumpcare.”

headlines.title: Trump indicates he’s open to working with El-Sayed on healthcare
headlines.description: Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed, D-Mich., said Sunday that he’s open to working with the administration to bring down costs and improve healthcare for Americans, after President Donald Trump made a post on social media seeming to leave the door open to possible universal healthcare. NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: Post Game: How Nvidia investigation could be ‘most alarming’ for White House
headlines.description: Kelly O’Donnell, Jeh Johnson and Marc Short join the Meet the Press Post Game for an extended conversation on the week’s biggest political stories.

headlines.title: Chris Van Hollen says Democrats won’t gain Americans’ trust by going back to ‘business as usual’
headlines.description: Sen. Chris Van Hollen (D-Md.) joins Meet the Press to discuss his campaign to become the Democrats’ new Senate Leader, and lays out his vision for governing as Democrats prepare to take back control of Congress.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: FBI investigating potential breach of its crime database
headlines.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its National Crime Information Center, two people briefed on the matter told NBC News Friday.

headlines.title: Trump formally ends minting of the penny after nearly 250 years of production
headlines.description: The U.S. Mint, which began producing the currency in 1793, has said it costs nearly 4 cents to make each penny.

headlines.title: Iraqi security forces deploy in Iran-backed militia stronghold
headlines.description: JURF AL-SAKHAR, Iraq — Iraqi security forces deployed in Jurf al-Sakhar, a stronghold of the Kataib Hezbollah armed group, on Friday under a deal that seeks to limit the reach of Iran’s most powerful Shi’ite militia ally in the country without provoking a confrontation.
